biography: As an energy executive, advisor, and board member with a career spanning energy, tech, and infrastructure, Sam serves as VP, Energy & Sustainability at Beale Infrastructure, a leading gigascale datacenter developer. He previously held leadership roles at long-duration energy storage and EV charging infrastructure startups, and served as the founding Director of Sustainability at Lyft. Prior, Sam spent 10 years at Google, where he co-led the company's achievement of 100% renewable energy. Sam earned his BA in Physics from Williams College and MS in Energy and Resources from UC Berkeley, where his research focused on wind energy and plug-in vehicles, respectively.
